budget_items.what_was_recorded: The cost of connections presented at the ZBA hearing was revised downward, and the revised figure was sent to Commissioners and the ZBA.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission's letter stated that waiving fees could put the Sewer Division into bankruptcy. No figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: if they waive the fees, it could put the sewer division into bankruptcy

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bill said regular maintenance is funded but the department needs money for pump station repairs. No figure was printed.
